content: Hex stickers produced by hexSticker R package (sticker() function). Standard dimensions follow http://hexb.in/sticker.html spec. Output PNG; SVG not mentioned in hexSticker docs. usethis::use_logo() places logo.png/logo.svg in man/figures/ and adds .Rbuildignore entry. pkgdown auto-detects logo.png in man/figures/ for navbar + favicons. build_favicons() reads the logo and generates pkgdown/favicon/ set. Community convention: ~2400x2772px PNG, transparent background. h_fill/h_color control hex color; showtext allows Google Fonts. No formal CRAN logo standard; convention driven by rOpenSci/tidyverse ecosystem.
